{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Input contains value and schema; schema nodes use object, array, string, integer, boolean, or null types. Input and output are JSON-compatible Python values.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["input", "output", "schema nodes"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The interface accepts the specified value/schema structure and produces JSON-serializable output.", "All six specified schema types are represented."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Input {value:JSON,schema:node}.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Input structure."},
        {"quote": "Schema type is object,array,string,integer,boolean,null.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Schema type vocabulary."},
        {"quote": "Input and output are JSON-compatible Python values.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Value domain."},
        {"quote": "The function receives a JSON value and returns a JSON-serializable value.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Serialization requirement."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Provide a pure deterministic Python 3 solve(data) function in solution.py.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["solution.py", "solve"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["solution.py exposes solve(data).", "Repeated equivalent inputs produce equivalent outputs with identical diagnostic ordering.", "Calling solve does not mutate caller-owned input or schema."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Implement solution.py with a pure solve(data) function.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required implementation interface and purity."},
        {"quote": "Implement a pure deterministic Python 3 function solve(data) in solution.py.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Language and determinism."},
        {"quote": "Implement solution.py with a pure solve(data) function.", "origin": "inferred", "interpretation": "Purity includes preserving caller-owned values.", "justification": "Mutation of supplied input or schema would be an observable side effect."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "resource_constraint",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Use only the Python standard library and perform no external I/O.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["implementation", "function execution"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["No third-party dependencies are used.", "Execution performs no external I/O."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Use Python standard library only, no external I/O.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Dependency and I/O restrictions."},
        {"quote": "Use only the standard library, no external I/O.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Repeated restrictions."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "E1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "error_semantics",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Check node type, treating booleans as distinct from integers. A mismatch emits exactly a type diagnostic at that node, preserves its value, and stops validation below or within that node.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["every visited node"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Boolean values fail integer validation.", "A mismatched node emits {path: node pointer, error: 'type'}.", "A mismatched node is unchanged and produces no descendant, range, or enum diagnostics."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Boolean is not integer.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Type separation."},
        {"quote": "Type mismatch emits {path,error:'type'} and leaves that node unchanged without descending.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Mismatch diagnostic and validation short circuit."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Object schemas support optional properties maps, required name lists, and an additional boolean whose omitted value is true.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["object schemas"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Omitting additional permits unknown properties.", "Properties and required are optional schema fields."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Object schema has optional properties map, required name list, additional bool default true.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Object schema fields and default."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Visit known object property names in sorted order. Insert a deep copy of a missing property's default and recursively validate it. If no default exists, emit required for a missing required property; otherwise skip it. Recursively validate present known properties.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["type-matching object nodes"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D2", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "Q1", "relation": "blocked_by"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Known properties are processed in sorted name order.", "Defaults take precedence over missing-required diagnostics.", "Inserted mutable defaults share no mutable storage with schema defaults.", "Present and inserted known properties undergo recursive validation.", "Missing optional properties without defaults are absent from the returned value."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Visit property names in sorted order: missing property with default is inserted by deep copy then validated;", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Ordering, insertion, copying, and validation."},
        {"quote": "otherwise missing required emits 'required';", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required diagnostic."},
        {"quote": "otherwise skip.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Optional missing property behavior."},
        {"quote": "Validate present known properties recursively, then emit 'additional' for unknown original properties in sorted order when additional:false, retaining them.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Recursive validation of known properties."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "E2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "error_semantics",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "After known-property processing, emit additional diagnostics for unknown properties present in the original object, sorted by name, only when additional is false; retain those properties.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["type-matching object nodes"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D2", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Unknown original properties remain in the output.", "additional:false yields one additional diagnostic per unknown original property in sorted order after known-property diagnostics.", "additional:true or omitted additional yields no additional diagnostics."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Validate present known properties recursively, then emit 'additional' for unknown original properties in sorted order when additional:false, retaining them.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Additional-property diagnostic ordering and retention."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O3",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Recursively validate array elements from left to right using schema.items.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["type-matching array nodes"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Element validation follows increasing index order.", "Each element uses the items schema and its index-based pointer."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Arrays validate items left to right via schema.items.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Array recursion and ordering."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "E3",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "error_semantics",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For type-matching integers, enforce inclusive minimum and maximum bounds and emit range on violation. Subsequently check scalar enum membership and emit enum on violation.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["type-matching scalar nodes"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "Q2", "relation": "blocked_by"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Integers equal to either bound pass that bound.", "An integer outside an applicable bound emits range.", "A scalar outside its enum emits enum.", "If both checks fail, range precedes enum."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "Integer minimum/maximum inclusive violations emit 'range', then scalar enum membership violations emit 'enum'.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Scalar constraints and diagnostic ordering."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "I1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "invariant",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Validate defaults even when they are invalid, and preserve all inserted defaults despite validation errors.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["default insertion", "validation"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Invalid defaults produce their applicable validation diagnostics.", "Validation errors never undo inserted defaults, including defaults inserted recursively."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Defaults may themselves be invalid.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Invalid defaults must be supported."},
        {"quote": "validation errors do not roll back defaults.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Persistent default insertion."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O4",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Diagnostic paths are JSON Pointers: escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1 in each path segment, and use the empty string for the root.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all diagnostic paths"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Root diagnostics use ''.", "Nested pointers concatenate slash-prefixed escaped segments.", "Literal ~ and / in property names are escaped as ~0 and ~1 respectively."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Paths are JSON Pointers with ~ and / escaped;", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "JSON Pointer encoding."},
        {"quote": "root ''.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Root path."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O5",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Return an object containing value as the default-filled value and errors as diagnostics in the specified traversal order, preserving the requested interface structure and ordering.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["return value"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Return structure is {value: transformed value, errors: diagnostic list}.", "Each diagnostic has path and error fields.", "The errors list preserves sorted object traversal, subsequent additional diagnostics, left-to-right array traversal, and range-before-enum ordering."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Return {value:default-filled value,errors:[diagnostics in traversal order]};", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Return structure and diagnostic sequence."},
        {"quote": "Preserve the specified input/output structure and exact ordering.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact interface and ordering."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O6",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Satisfy both public examples: insert a=2 and retain z=1 with only /z additional; preserve [true,4] with /0 type followed by /1 range.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["public examples"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The first example returns value {a:2,z:1} and errors [{error:'additional',path:'/z'}].", "The second example returns value [true,4] and errors [{error:'type',path:'/0'},{error:'range',path:'/1'}]."],
      "sources": [{"quote": "[{\"input\": {\"schema\": {\"additional\": false, \"properties\": {\"a\": {\"default\": 2, \"type\": \"integer\"}}, \"required\": [\"a\"], \"type\": \"object\"}, \"value\": {\"z\": 1}}, \"output\": {\"errors\": [{\"error\": \"additional\", \"path\": \"/z\"}], \"value\": {\"a\": 2, \"z\": 1}}}, {\"input\": {\"schema\": {\"items\": {\"maximum\": 3, \"type\": \"integer\"}, \"type\": \"array\"}, \"value\": [true, 4]}, \"output\": {\"errors\": [{\"error\": \"type\", \"path\": \"/0\"}, {\"error\": \"range\", \"path\": \"/1\"}], \"value\": [true, 4]}}]", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Concrete behavioral examples."}]
    },
    {
      "id": "Q1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "ambiguity",
      "role": "open_question",
      "statement": "Clarify whether required names absent from properties are checked, and where their diagnostics occur in sorted traversal.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["object schemas with required names absent from properties"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Specify whether traversal covers properties names alone or the union of properties and required names."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Object schema has optional properties map, required name list, additional bool default true.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Independent properties and required fields."},
        {"quote": "Visit property names in sorted order: missing property with default is inserted by deep copy then validated;", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Traversal set is not explicitly defined for undeclared required names."},
        {"quote": "otherwise missing required emits 'required';", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Required checking could extend beyond properties."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "Q2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "ambiguity",
      "role": "open_question",
      "statement": "Clarify enum equality between booleans and numeric values, for which Python equality can conflate distinct JSON types.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["scalar enum membership"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Specify whether true matches 1 and false matches 0 in enum membership."],
      "sources": [
        {"quote": "Boolean is not integer.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Explicit type distinction."},
        {"quote": "Integer minimum/maximum inclusive violations emit 'range', then scalar enum membership violations emit 'enum'.", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Enum equality semantics are unspecified."}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "category_review": {
    "entities": "JSON-compatible input/output and six schema types; object schema fields.",
    "preconditions": "No caller assumptions stated.",
    "postconditions": "Pure deterministic interface, recursive defaults and validation, pointers, return structure, and public examples.",
    "invariants": "Invalid defaults are validated and inserted defaults survive errors.",
    "safety_properties": "Purity and retained values are covered by guarantees.",
    "liveness_properties": "None stated.",
    "resource_constraints": "Standard library only; no external I/O.",
    "error_semantics": "Type, required, additional, range, and enum diagnostics with prescribed ordering.",
    "explicit_non_goals": "None stated.",
    "ambiguities": "Required names outside properties; boolean/numeric enum equality."
  },
  "clauses": [
    {"clause_id": "C1", "quote": "Software engineering task D16: Recursive schema defaults with deterministic diagnostics", "disposition": "context", "refs": [], "note": "Task title; detailed behavior is specified by subsequent clauses."},
    {"clause_id": "C2", "quote": "Implement solution.py with a pure solve(data) function.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C3", "quote": "Input and output are JSON-compatible Python values.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C4", "quote": "Use Python standard library only, no external I/O.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["R1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C5", "quote": "Input {value:JSON,schema:node}.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C6", "quote": "Schema type is object,array,string,integer,boolean,null.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C7", "quote": "Boolean is not integer.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["E1", "Q2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C8", "quote": "Type mismatch emits {path,error:'type'} and leaves that node unchanged without descending.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["E1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C9", "quote": "Object schema has optional properties map, required name list, additional bool default true.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D2", "Q1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C10", "quote": "Visit property names in sorted order: missing property with default is inserted by deep copy then validated;", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2", "Q1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C11", "quote": "otherwise missing required emits 'required';", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2", "Q1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C12", "quote": "otherwise skip.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C13", "quote": "Validate present known properties recursively, then emit 'additional' for unknown original properties in sorted order when additional:false, retaining them.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2", "E2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C14", "quote": "Arrays validate items left to right via schema.items.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O3"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C15", "quote": "Integer minimum/maximum inclusive violations emit 'range', then scalar enum membership violations emit 'enum'.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["E3", "Q2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C16", "quote": "Defaults may themselves be invalid.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["I1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C17", "quote": "Paths are JSON Pointers with ~ and / escaped;", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O4"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C18", "quote": "root ''.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O4"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C19", "quote": "Return {value:default-filled value,errors:[diagnostics in traversal order]};", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O5"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C20", "quote": "validation errors do not roll back defaults.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["I1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C21", "quote": "Implement a pure deterministic Python 3 function solve(data) in solution.py.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C22", "quote": "Use only the standard library, no external I/O.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["R1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C23", "quote": "The function receives a JSON value and returns a JSON-serializable value.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C24", "quote": "Preserve the specified input/output structure and exact ordering.", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O5"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C25", "quote": "Public examples (additional held-out cases will be scored):\\n[{\\\"input\\\": {\\\"schema\\\": {\\\"additional\\\": false, \\\"properties\\\": {\\\"a\\\": {\\\"default\\\": 2, \\\"type\\\": \\\"integer\\\"}}, \\\"required\\\": [\\\"a\\\"], \\\"type\\\": \\\"object\\\"}, \\\"value\\\": {\\\"z\\\": 1}}, \\\"output\\\": {\\\"errors\\\": [{\\\"error\\\": \\\"additional\\\", \\\"path\\\": \\\"/z\\\"}], \\\"value\\\": {\\\"a\\\": 2, \\\"z\\\": 1}}}, {\\\"input\\\": {\\\"schema\\\": {\\\"items\\\": {\\\"maximum\\\": 3, \\\"type\\\": \\\"integer\\\"}, \\\"type\\\": \\\"array\\\"}, \\\"value\\\": [true, 4]}, \\\"output\\\": {\\\"errors\\\": [{\\\"error\\\": \\\"type\\\", \\\"path\\\": \\\"/0\\\"}, {\\\"error\\\": \\\"range\\\", \\\"path\\\": \\\"/1\\\"}], \\\"value\\\": [true, 4]}}]", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O6"], "note": "Examples specify behavior; held-out scoring is evaluation context."}
  ],
  "assumptions": [],
  "ambiguities": [
    {
      "id": "Q1",
      "alternatives": [
        {"id": "properties_only", "description": "Traverse only properties-map names; required names absent from that map are not checked."},
        {"id": "union", "description": "Traverse the sorted union of properties-map and required names, emitting required for missing undeclared required names."}
      ],
      "affected_obligations": ["O2"],
      "impact": ["correctness", "failure_behavior"],
      "proposed_default": null
    },
    {
      "id": "Q2",
      "alternatives": [
        {"id": "json_typed", "description": "Enum equality distinguishes booleans from numbers, so true does not match 1 and false does not match 0."},
        {"id": "python_equality", "description": "Enum membership follows Python equality, so true matches 1 and false matches 0."}
      ],
      "affected_obligations": ["E3"],
      "impact": ["correctness", "numeric_semantics"],
      "proposed_default": null
    }
  ],
  "selected_defaults": []
}
